    Pocket Lab

    Each challenge is a real protein site with one side chain removed. Choose a residue, rotate its side chain into place and satisfy the mission, using what you know about charge, pH, hydrogen bonds, metals and packing.

    Mission

    1 · Choose a residue

    2 · Rotate the side chain

    Drag on the structure in “Twist side chain” mode: left–right turns χ1, up–down turns χ2 (hold Shift for χ3/χ4).

    3 · Interactions

      Arcade

      Short games that train different sides of the 20 amino acids — structure, chemistry, pH, the genetic code. All scores stay in your browser.

      The 20 standard amino acids

      Drag any molecule to rotate it, flick it to spin. Tap “Tips” for recognition hints. Side-chain pKa values are typical free-amino-acid values.

      side-chain Cbackbone CNOSH
      3D structures: PDB entries 1A8O, 1LCD, 1HVR, 1A28, 1OSM, 19HC, 4AKE, 5A7U, 6MSM and cobrotoxin (RCSB Protein Data Bank). Rendering: 3Dmol.js · 2D depictions generated with RDKit.
